name: channel.orbit/mcp
title: Orbit Channel
description: The media station for AI agents: buy, rent and stream music. Artists are paid directly, no pooling.

tools.name: get_featured
tools.description: Today's featured track on Orbit with a free 20-second preview. Takes no input and needs no authorization — a good first call to see what Orbit offers. The track changes once a day.

tools.name: search_music
tools.description: Search the Orbit music catalog by artist, title, genre or a natural request. No authorization needed. Returns up to 10 tracks with their articleId, prices in EURc and a link.

query.description: Search for artist, song, or natural request such as 'find me a popular dance track'. No login required.

genre.description: Optional genre or subgenre, for example dance, techno, house, jazz, rock.

sort.description: Optional result ordering. Defaults to popular, or latest when explicitly requested.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 5, capped at 10.

tools.name: get_media_access
tools.description: Get playable audio for a track. Without authorization: a free 20-second preview. Signed in: the full stream for tracks the user owns or streams.

articleId.description: Article ID from search_music, get_my_collection or get_recommendations.

tools.name: request_stream_access
tools.description: Grant the user 30 days of streaming for one track. Spends the user's Orbit credits; a track that is already active is returned without charging again. Needs the user's Orbit account: the assistant asks them to sign in on orbit.channel the first time.

articleId.description: Article ID of the music to stream.

tools.name: purchase_music
tools.description: Buy permanent access to one track. Spends the user's Orbit credits and cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first. Needs the user's Orbit account: the assistant asks them to sign in on orbit.channel the first time.

articleId.description: Article ID of the music to purchase.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show the user's Orbit credit balance. Needs the user's Orbit account: the assistant asks them to sign in on orbit.channel the first time.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Suggest up to 5 tracks the user does not have yet, based on what they already stream. Needs the user's Orbit account: the assistant asks them to sign in on orbit.channel the first time.

tools.name: claim_welcome_gift
tools.description: Claim free Orbit credits for first-comers: a limited number of accounts get a one-time gift (get_featured shows how many are left). Needs the user's Orbit account: the assistant asks them to sign in on orbit.channel the first time.

tools.name: get_my_collection
tools.description: List the tracks the user currently has streaming access to. Needs the user's Orbit account: the assistant asks them to sign in on orbit.channel the first time.

tools.name: get_partner_context
tools.description: Partner accounts only. The signed-in partner account: its name, its role (operator of a channel, distributor, or none) and the public values of its channel. Call this first. Company, contract and payout data are never part of it.

tools.name: update_channel
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Change the public page of the partner's own channel. Only the fields you send are written; an empty string clears a text. Overwrites the current values, so confirm the new text with the user first.

name.description: Channel name. Cannot change once it is named in a signed agreement.

accentColor.description: Hex colour such as #7c5cff; must be readable on the dark page.

operatorBio.description: Presentation of the person or team running the channel.

operatorUrl.description: The operator's website, http or https.

picks.description: Selector's picks: up to three article ids from list_channel_releases, in order; [] clears.

tools.name: list_channel_releases
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Every release on the partner's channel, to choose Selector's picks from.

tools.name: list_channel_posts
tools.description: Partner accounts only. The channel's news posts, drafts included.

tools.name: save_channel_post
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Create a news post on the channel (no id) or update one (with id). With published: true it is live on the public channel page at once; without it, it stays a draft.

id.description: Post id from list_channel_posts to update; omit to create.

imageUrl.description: Image URL returned by a channel_news upload.

published.description: true publishes, false keeps a draft.

tools.name: delete_channel_post
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Permanently delete one news post of the channel. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: remove_channel_image
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Clear the channel's wallpaper, logo or operator photo. To replace one, use create_image_upload instead.

tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Find artists by name: the partner's own plus public profiles on Orbit. Use it before create_artist to avoid a duplicate.

tools.name: list_artists
tools.description: Partner accounts only. The artists the partner owns or distributes, by name. Capped at 100 per call; narrow with a filter.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Partner accounts only. The full profile of one of the partner's artists: biography, links and whether it has images.

tools.name: create_artist
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Create an artist owned by the partner. The public address (slug) is made from the name and cannot be changed later, so check the spelling with the user first.

type.description: One of: artist, musician, singer-songwriter, band, dj, collective, composer, producer, director, photographer, record label, digital creator, visual artist, other.

country.description: ISO country code, such as HR or DE.

tools.name: update_artist
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Edit an artist the partner owns. Only the fields you send are written. Overwrites the current values.

website.description: website link or handle; an empty string clears it.

youtube.description: youtube link or handle; an empty string clears it.

soundcloud.description: soundcloud link or handle; an empty string clears it.

beatport.description: beatport link or handle; an empty string clears it.

facebook.description: facebook link or handle; an empty string clears it.

twitter.description: twitter link or handle; an empty string clears it.

linkedin.description: linkedin link or handle; an empty string clears it.

tiktok.description: tiktok link or handle; an empty string clears it.

instagram.description: instagram link or handle; an empty string clears it.

bandcamp.description: bandcamp link or handle; an empty string clears it.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Partner accounts only. The partner's releases, drafts included, 25 per page. Narrow with a filter on the name.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Partner accounts only. One release in full: details, state (draft, active), artists, prices and completeness.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Create a draft release owned by the partner. It stays invisible until Orbit reviews and activates it; nothing here publishes. The public address (slug) is made from the name and cannot be changed later, so check the title with the user first.

channelId.description: Only when the partner publishes on more than one channel.

tools.name: update_release
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Edit a release the partner owns. Only the fields you send are written. Overwrites the current values.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

price.description: Price to buy, in EUR; null clears it.

rentCredits.description: Price of one day of streaming, in whole credits.

tools.name: set_release_artists
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Set the artists of a release, in order, replacing the current ones. Up to ten, each the partner's own artist or an approved public one (ids from list_artists, search_artists or create_artist).

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: delete_release_draft
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Permanently delete a release that is still an untouched draft, with its files. Confirm with the user first.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: create_release_preview_link
tools.description: Partner accounts only. A link, valid seven days, that shows the release as it will look before it is public. Give it to the user to check the result.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: list_tracks
tools.description: Partner accounts only. The files of a release in order, with their credits and processing state.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: create_track_upload
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Get a single-use link to upload one audio file (MP3, WAV, FLAC) or, for films, one video (MP4, MOV), up to 2 GB, valid for 10 minutes. Send the file to it with HTTP PUT; the response is the stored track. Give the track its name, position and credits here. Request one link per file.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

filename.description: The file's name; its extension decides the type.

name.description: Track title; defaults to the filename.

preview.description: Films only: this file is the trailer.

tools.name: update_track
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Rename a track, mark it as bonus material, or edit its credits. To replace the audio, remove the track and upload again.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

extra.description: true marks the track as bonus material.

tools.name: reorder_tracks
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Put the tracks of a release in the given order. Send every track id of the release.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: remove_track
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Remove a track from a release and delete its stored file. Confirm with the user first.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: Partner accounts only. The editions of a release with their prices, and the kinds that can still be added.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: create_edition
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Add an edition to a release: standard, premium, or a numbered signature edition. One per kind. The kind and, for a signature edition, the size cannot be changed afterwards.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

size.description: Signature editions only: number of copies (default 1000).

tools.name: update_edition
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Change an edition's price or whether it is listed for sale.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: remove_edition
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Remove an edition nobody owns a copy of. Confirm with the user first.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

tools.name: create_image_upload
tools.description: Partner accounts only. Get a single-use link to upload one image (JPG or PNG, up to 9 MB), valid for 10 minutes. Send the file to it with HTTP PUT; the response says where the image is stored. Channel images, artist images and a release cover replace the current one. A channel_news upload returns a URL to pass to save_channel_post.

filename.description: The file's name, ending in .jpg, .jpeg or .png.
